messages:
Maria: Heads up — target cutover for v1.8.0 is Thu 10:00 PT. We need the docs site deploy + SDK docs regen done before cutoff. Who's on changelog bump and branch pin?
Alex: I'm taking changelog. Will open the PR and tag it with /release-note today. Expecting to finish by EOD. :thumbsup:
Raj: I can run the SDK regen tomorrow morning and push artifacts to the release bucket. Do we want a minor bump to 1.8.0 for the SDK package?
Shaun: Yes bump minor to 1.8.0. Update package.json and header in SDK docs. I can review the PR once Alex opens it.
Maria: Also need the small runtime bugfixes cherry-picked into release/v1.8 before we build artifacts. Example commands: 
```
git checkout release/v1.8
git cherry-pick abc1234
git cherry-pick def5678
```
Raj: Cherrypicks queued locally, pushing shortly and will ping for review. @Shaun can you watch the review?
docs-bot: CI: SDK regen job queued — https://ci.redwood/jenkins/regen/2345 :hourglass:
Alex: Changelog PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478 — entries for runtime fix + console UI tweak. Please /lgtm if looks good.
Shaun: Reviewing now. Quick note — translations may need a heads up if any UI strings changed. Maria, can you ping intl-team?
Maria: Done — left a note in #localization and emailed the translations queue. Also posting a short deploy checklist here:
- merge changelog PR
- SDK docs regen job green on staging
- release branch pinned and artifacts built
- docs site deploy window scheduled (Thu 11:00 PT) and ops freeze start
Raj: Regen passed on staging, found one snippet mismatch, fixed it. Final artifacts uploading to release bucket now.
Alex: Tagged SDK package as v1.8.0 and uploaded artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/sdk/v1.8.0
Shaun: Changelog merged, left a tiny nit in a commit message but not blocking.
Maria: Great — I'll trigger docs-site deploy once artifacts are confirmed. If anything blocks, ping @here in this thread and we'll escalate. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
